config.realm_keys.title: Realm Keys
config.realm_keys.per_player_progression: If off, unlocking a dimension for one player unlocks it for everyone.
Play a title/sound when a player is granted access via a command.
config.realm_keys.enable_block_effects.t: Knockback, sounds and particles when a locked portal turns a player back.
config.realm_keys.first_discoverer_messa: Leave empty to use the translated default. Supports %player%, %dimension% and & color codes.
Fallback welcome title for any dimension without its own entry and that isn't Nether/End. Supports %dimension% and & color codes. Leave empty to show nothing.
config.realm_keys.default_locked_message: Fallback locked message for any dimension without its own entry and that isn't Nether/End. Supports %dimension% and & color codes. Leave empty to use the built-in generic message.
config.realm_keys.exempt_dimensions.tool: Dimensions that never require a key, regardless of lock state. Defaults to the overworld; clear the list to gate it too.
config.realm_keys.command_permission_lev: Op level required to run /realmkeys admin subcommands.
config.realm_keys.block_knockback_streng: How hard a player is pushed back when a locked portal turns them away.
config.realm_keys.effects.editor_hint: Sounds and particles for unlock/block/discovery effects live in realm_keys_settings.json as lists of {sound/particle id, volume/count, pitch/spread}. Edit the file, then run /realmkeys reload to apply changes without restarting.
